facts.text: Lincolnshire was incorporated on August 5, 1957, when land from the unincorporated Half Day area was purchased to build a residential subdivision.
Sysmex America, Zebra Technologies, and Quill Corporation all have their headquarters in Lincolnshire, making the village a hub for tech and manufacturing.
The Des Plaines River cuts through the village from north to south, while Illinois Route 22 crosses it east‑west, dividing Lincolnshire into two parts.
The Lincolnshire Community Nursery School, founded in 1973, welcomes preschoolers who live in the village’s eastern reaches.
Olympic medalist Robert Berland, who won gold in 1984 and silver in 1988, calls Lincolnshire home.
Lincolnshire began as part of the town of Half Day, the first region settled by non‑Native Americans in Lake County.
